summary.text: Mary Kunesh is a Democratic state senator who has represented Minnesota Senate District 39 since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A former school library media specialist, she previously served in the state House and in Senate District 41.

paragraphs.text: Mary Kunesh lives in New Brighton, Minnesota, and graduated from Cathedral High School.
She earned a bachelor's degree in elementary education from St. Catherine's University in 1995 and a master's degree in information media from St. Cloud State University in 2010.

Ballotpedia lists her career experience as including work as a library media specialist for Robbinsdale Area Schools and as an educator, and says she oversaw the New Brighton Parks, Recreation, and Environmental Commission.
Kunesh represented Minnesota House District 41B from 2017 to 2021 and Senate District 41 from 2021 to 2023.
She has represented Senate District 39 since January 3, 2023, succeeding Karin Housley.
